plugins.name: dstoic
plugins.description: Default plugin: diverge and converge skills (ideation in rounds, then a decision on Mat's own criteria), devil-advocate agent, hooks (tmux notifications, output dumps), statusline and security notes. Parked skills live in park/dstoic-skills/.

plugins.name: toolsmith
plugins.description: Plugin and skill authoring: create/edit skills, agents, plugins, CLAUDE.md files, search skills, manage dependencies

plugins.name: gist
plugins.description: Visual output an agent's reader grasps at a glance. Ships the Digital Stoic design system v0.6 "Tablette" (design-system): tokens, type, class vocabulary, inline-SVG chart parameters, and an assembler that injects the base CSS and base64 fonts so they never pass through context. Six demo screens (document, landing, dashboard, charts, decision, mini-app) kept in sync by a checker. Also ships verdict (ex review-html): self-contained review pages assembled from the design system, with cards typed by the action the reader takes and a JSON of deviations pasted back, plus its 108-entry visual grammar catalog and generator.
